living.ascii.input.c1_7_move_into_an_adj: C1.7: Move into an adjacent friendly villager to exchange tiles. NPCs can negotiate bottlenecks after a short wait, but busy healers, teachers and hostile actors will not yield. Use trafficlog to inspect witnessed exchanges. Sect politics and Willowford continue as usual.
living.ascii.input.c1_8_an_observed_qing: C1.8: An observed Qinghe medicine shortage may send the watchman to ask Reed Hall for relief. The steward must obtain real herbs at Willowford market and carry them to the shrine. The mission can fail or be withdrawn. Use relieflog for events you witnessed, or trafficlog for passage.
living.ascii.input.c1_9_stonebank_s_envo: C1.9: Stonebank's envoy periodically visits Qinghe to inspect the shrine. A shortage witnessed in person can provoke a competing physical aid shipment, paid with Stonebank funds. Both factions contend for finite market herbs. Use aidlog for events you witnessed; --c18 keeps the earlier campaign.
living.ascii.input.c2_0_qinghe_and_reed_: C2.0: Qinghe and Reed Hall may discover shortages locally. Requesters travel to prospective sponsors, collect offers, return to award the chosen institution, then wait for real market procurement and physical delivery. Contracts can expire or fail. Use contractlog for events you witnessed; --c19 retains the earlier autonomous faction campaign.
living.ascii.input.c2_1_institutions_ins: C2.1: Institutions inspect their own delivery sites before judging past providers. Confirmed deliveries earn local trust; missed deadlines reduce it. Those memories influence later in-person bids, never remote knowledge. Use contractlog and accountlog. --c20 keeps the original contract campaign.
living.ascii.input.c2_2_audit_findings_t: C2.2: Audit findings travel only by face-to-face testimony with provenance. Credible reports can open institutional disputes that change later contract awards, including suspension. Use contractlog, accountlog and infolog. --c21 keeps C2.1; --c20 keeps C2.0.
living.ascii.input.c2_3_you_can_witness_: C2.3: You can witness, examine a site, ask someone what they know, or tell a specific finding to someone beside you. examine, ask [id], tell [id] [event], and know. Gossip you only heard does not carry the same weight as evidence you checked. --c22 keeps C2.2; --c21 keeps C2.1; --c20 keeps C2.0.
living.ascii.input.c2_4_a_dead_carrier_s: C2.4: A dead carrier's herbs can be taken from the body. People who see you do it remember who you are. People who do not only notice that the cargo is gone. examine, ask, tell, know, and take [id]. --c23 keeps C2.3; --c22 keeps C2.2.
living.ascii.input.c2_5_attack_id_a_livi: C2.5: attack <id> a living courier or contract provider; carried herbs remain on the body. take <id> recovers them. bodies shows only corpses you discovered, not the killer. crimelog lists only your own actions or learned incidents. Witnesses identify attackers; nearby strangers only have a lead. contractlog, accountlog, infolog, know track consequences. --c24 keeps C2.4.
living.ascii.input.c2_7_find_a_body_then: C2.7: Find a body, then reportbody <npc> <body> face-to-face. The listener hears a corpse report after two turns, not a murder accusation. A watchman may travel to confirm it. bodies and crimelog show what you personally know. --c25 keeps C2.5; --c24 keeps C2.4.
living.ascii.input.c2_8_watchmen_who_see: C2.8: Watchmen who see a body can recover its real herbs and carry them back to the shrine when medicine is short. The body is not evidence of a killer. Use reportbody <npc> <body>, bodies and salvagelog. --c27 keeps C2.7; --c25 keeps C2.5.
living.ascii.input.c2_9_rival_sects_comp: C2.9: Rival sects compete for finite SpiritOre and JadeScript lots. Use lots, lotlog, claim <lot>, offerlot <npc> <lot> to sell a carried good face-to-face to Stonebank's envoy or Reed Hall's steward. Unseen goods stay private. --c28 preserves the previous campaign.
living.ascii.input.c3_0_keep_a_relic_to_: C3.0: Keep a relic to cultivate instead of selling. attune <lot> consumes carried SpiritOre into two one-hit wards or JadeScript into two ranged channel <npc> strikes. Use cultivation to inspect charges. --c29 preserves C2.9.
living.ascii.input.c3_1_seek_ren_zhi_33_: C3.1: Seek Ren Zhi (33) for Reed Palm or Stonebank's envoy (35) for Stone Fist. drill <teacher> twice face-to-face (one coin per lesson); martial and martiallog show personal and witnessed progress. technique <npc> uses your learned form; wait eases strain. Sect oaths restrict rival lessons. NPC disciples train without you. --c30 keeps C3.0.
living.ascii.input.c3_2_gather_real_herb: C3.2: Gather real herbs; at Qinghe shrine or Reed Hall drawqi spends one herb for one Qi. circulate spends Qi: a rested body opens a channel; strain or wounds obstruct it. Two open channels and Qi are required for technique. Blockage requires mend at a staffed clinic, using real shrine medicine. meridians and meridianlog show known condition. --c31 keeps C3.1.
living.ascii.input.c3_3_real_blows_can_l: C3.3: Real blows can leave lasting arm or leg wounds. Severe arm wounds weaken strikes; severe leg wounds slow movement on alternating ticks. Injured NPCs retreat and seek care. At a staffed clinic treatwounds spends one shrine herb and heals one wound; wounds and woundlog show your condition and witnessed events. --c32 keeps C3.2.
living.ascii.input.c3_4_injured_npcs_wit: C3.4: Injured NPCs without treatment money can gather and sell physical herbs, pay a present medic, recover, and resume interrupted ambitions. agency <visible npc> explains current circumstances; agencylog lists only decisions and transactions you witnessed. --c33 keeps free-care C3.3.
living.ascii.input.c3_5_reed_hall_tracks: C3.5: Reed Hall tracks persisted rank and merit for both you and NPC members. Complete shrine duty to reach Disciple (free Reed Hall martial drills, Reed Strike study, and Hall Qi access), and repeat Hall duty from real Hall offerings to reach Senior Disciple and claim one physical herb with allocate. NPC members perform duties, advance, and assume Elder office on succession without you. sect and sectlog inspect known standing and witnessed events. --c34 keeps C3.4.
